Extract console interaction into Ui class
commitResults.messageBody: Move scanner ownership and all user-facing output out of Zikiai so the main class can focus on command workflow. Preserve the existing console behavior verified by the complete UI test plan.

commitResults.messageTitle: Encapsulate task collection in TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Move task addition, deletion, status changes, retrieval, and counting behind a dedicated TaskList abstraction. Update Zikiai, Ui, and Storage to use that abstraction while preserving all existing command behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Move command recognition, task-number validation, task creation syntax, date conversion, and storage-field validation out of Zikiai. Keep Zikiai focused on coordinating Parser, TaskList, Storage, and Ui without changing console behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-MoreOOP into master
Organize project classes into Java packages
commitResults.messageBody: Group UI, parser, storage, task, and exception classes into responsibility-based packages while preserving src/main/java as the source root. Update the UI test runner and README to use the qualified zikiai.Zikiai main class.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-Packages into master

Configure Gradle to build and run Zikiai
commitResults.messageBody: Set the application entry point to the packaged zikiai.Zikiai class and rename the self-contained Shadow JAR to zikiai.jar so the Gradle build matches the chatbot branding.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage for parser and task list behavior
commitResults.messageBody: Test command parsing, validation boundaries, invalid inputs, defensive task-list ownership, collection changes, and completion-state transitions. Document the requirement to maintain JUnit coverage for the top half of high-value methods after code changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage for concrete task representations
commitResults.messageBody: Verify Todo, Deadline, and Event display and storage formats, including completion-status changes and the distinct friendly versus ISO deadline date representations.

Document executable Zikiai JAR distribution
commitResults.messageBody: Explain how to build the Shadow JAR, locate the generated artifact, run it independently with Java 25, and publish it as a release asset without committing generated binaries.

commitResults.messageTitle: Complete Javadocs for production APIs
commitResults.messageBody: Document the application entry point, status formatting, and concrete task representations. Add explicit constructors where needed so generated API documentation is complete and warning-free.

Apply SE-EDU coding standards
commitResults.messageBody:
Project-specific coding and Git conventions are not yet encoded for future
changes.

Add reusable skills and require agents to apply them. Align existing Java
documentation, naming, and wrapping with the Java standard so future work
starts from a consistent baseline.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch-A-CodingStandard into master
commitResults.messageBody:
The coding-standard branch adds reusable SE-EDU Java and Git guidance and
aligns existing source documentation and naming.

Merge it after the JavaDoc increment, preserving both documentation intent
and coding-standard punctuation in the resolved overlaps.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task search by keyword
commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot narrow the task list when looking for a specific item.

Add a Find command that searches task descriptions while preserving order
and state. Validate empty keywords, report searches with no matches clearly,
and cover positive and negative behavior with JUnit and UI tests.
